description: Get a compact summary of a Figma design file by its file key: name, last modified time, version, editor type, role, thumbnail URL, and the list of top-level pages (id, name, type, child count). Use to understand the structure of a Figma design file without fetching the full node tree.

depth.description: How many levels of the document tree to traverse (default 2). Lower values return less data.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (the segment after /file/ or /design/ in a Figma URL).

name: get_file
title: Get File
